# Per-function coverage floors for pkg/plugin (#1117), in percent, checked by
# scripts/coverage-ratchet.sh against the merged (unit + integration)
# `go tool cover -func` table the Coverage workflow writes.
#
# Row: <import path>.<Func> <min-percent>. No file or line: a move inside
# the package keeps its row. A row with no match in the table fails the run,
# so a rename or delete edits this file, and scripts/check-coverage-floor.sh
# reads that edit on every PR.
#
# Rules, as for .github/coverage-baseline.txt:
#   - Raise a floor in the same PR that earns the improvement.
#   - Never lower a floor without a recorded decision in the PR body.
#
# Seeded from the merged profile of Coverage run 36426064859 (dev at
# 0fca080), read with go tool cover -func. One row differs from that run:
#   - nftForwardPolicy 0.0 -> 88.2.
#     The tests that drive it run in a child process, and the child's
#     counters were discarded; renumberNetnsChild now passes it the parent's
#     coverage dir. Value: that run's merged profile summed with this tree's
#     unit profile. It is an estimate until a Coverage run reads it.
#
# #657 PR 2 adds createEndpoint 99.4 and createParentAttachedEndpoint 99.4.
# They are UNIT-ONLY readings (go test -coverprofile ./pkg/plugin/ on the
# PR head), a lower bound: the tests that earn them stub the kernel and
# skip nowhere, and the merged profile unions their blocks. Last merged
# readings before them (run 37274363352): 91.5 and 92.0.
#
# #1301 recorded decision, 2026-10-09: re-measured on Go 1.27.2, whose cover
# tool counts statements differently from 1.27.1, from the merged table of
# coverage run 37939950726 (artifact coverage-func-37939950726); each floor
# 0.5 under its reading, old -> new (read):

#   DeleteEndpoint 89.6 -> 86.7 (87.2), Join 83.5 -> 83.6 (84.1),
#   Leave 96.3 -> 94.2 (94.7), ipamBindingFor 88.5 -> 88.0 (88.5),
#   createBridgeNetwork 77.5 -> 81.3 (81.8),
#   createParentAttachedNetwork 94.1 -> 93.6 (94.1),
